accessibility:
- Uses `role="alert"` for screen reader announcement.
- Has `aria-live="polite"` for non-intrusive notifications.
- The closable button has `aria-label="Close"`.
- `pauseOnHover` lets users keep the toast visible while reading.
- `cancelable` (default `true`) supports Escape-key dismiss.
summary: The `Toast` component provides brief notification messages with optional action and cancel buttons.

parts.summary: The `Toast` component provides brief notification messages with optional action and cancel buttons.

props.name: actionType
props.description: Color variant — colors the **action button** text.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration in ms before auto-close. `0` disables auto-close.

props.name: indefinite
props.description: Keeps the toast visible until dismissed.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether clicking the toast (or outside it) dismisses it.

props.name: closable
props.description: Show an explicit close (X) button. Default: false.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause auto-close timer on hover. Default: false.

props.name: cancelable
props.description: Whether the toast can be dismissed with Escape. Default: true.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Callback when the action button is clicked.

props.name: container
props.description: CSS selector or DOM node to mount the toast into.

props.name: inline
props.description: Renders inline instead of using a portal.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the toast element.
